bio.text: Don Gaetz represents District 1 in the Florida Senate, to which Gaetz was elected in 2024; Gaetz previously served in the Senate from 2006 to 2016 and was Senate President from 2012 to 2014.
Gaetz was Okaloosa County school superintendent from 2000 to 2006, chaired Triumph Gulf Coast from 2018 to 2023, and served on the Florida Ethics Commission from 2021 to 2023.

Gaetz is a retired healthcare executive, born in Rugby, North Dakota, who moved to Florida in 1978. Gaetz holds a B.S. from Concordia College (1971) and a master of public administration from Troy State University (1999).
